title: Introduce KMS-backed signing, rotate legacy keystore, and add compatibility shim for old tokens
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Replace in-repo PEM keystore and ad-hoc signing helpers with a KMS/HSM-backed signing service, rotate all signing keys used for SSO/SAML assertions and JWTs, and introduce a transient compatibility shim that accepts legacy token formats for up to 30 days. Motivation: multiple transitive dependency CVEs were flagged in our saml and jwt helper libs during the Feb 2026 supply-chain review; the current keystore format is brittle for automated rotation and requires manual secret handling. Goals: (1) integrate Redwood KMS connector for signing and key versioning; (2) migrate services off file-based PEMs to fetch verification keys from the public key endpoint; (3) rotate keys and perform coordinated backfill; (4) provide a lightweight compatibility shim that decodes legacy tokens so long-tail clients have a migration window. Non-goals: long-term maintenance of legacy token format beyond the migration window, or redesign of SSO protocol flows.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Aisha: Created ticket after supply-chain review flagged openssl and saml helper CVEs. Initial design doc linked.

2026-03-03 - Miguel: Spike completed - KMS signing latency is ~3ms for batch operations, our hot-path accepts an extra 1–2ms. Trade-off: stronger security vs small token issuance latency increase. Decided to cache signatures for 2s for high-throughput flows.

2026-03-05 - Engineering review (Liam Cheng): Reviewed migration plan. Concern raised about key rotation orchestration across Dedicated and Private deployments; action: add an opt-in agent for Private customers to run key sync.
2026-03-06 - Security (Rosa Li): Requested threat model update and formal security review. Added requirement for HSM-backed KMS configuration for enterprise customers.

2026-03-07 - Miguel: Opened compatibility shim RFC. Shim will run as a small verification adapter that tries legacy token parse rules once and emits metric auth.legacy_parse_attempts. Will degrade and then stop accepting legacy tokens after the window.

2026-03-08 - QA (Samira Patel): Integration tests added for token issuance and verification across three flows: hosted API, Dedicated, and Private. Found a timing issue in canary where verification cache caused a 401 for 4 seconds during rotation; fixed by extending cache TTL to 10s for transition period.
2026-03-10 - Miguel: Preparing canary rollout to 10% of auth traffic next week. Coordinated with SRE to add alerts: auth.signing_errors, auth.verification_errors, auth.rotation_latency.
2026-03-10 - Aisha: Security review required: see security_review_required flag. Planning post-rotation audit and compliance checklist for SOC2/ISO artifacts.
notes_for_rollout: Rollout plan: 1) internal staging smoke tests; 2) 10% canary for 48h with alerting; 3) account-limited rollout to customers with SSO enabled for 7 days; 4) full cutover. Backout plan: switch verification endpoint to legacy public key bundle and abort rotation. Compatibility shim will provide 30-day grace before rejecting legacy tokens. Monitor dashboards: dashboards/redwood/auth-signing, dashboards/redwood/auth-verification-errors.
postmortem_if_issues: If signing or verification errors exceed 0.1% of auth traffic during canary, pause rollout and open incident. Required post-rotation audit: verify all services no longer reference file-based PEMs and run key inventory report.
